name: Exact neighborhood-type quotient upper construction
mathematical_input: exact full accumulated complement neighborhoods at G16, including old bands and fallback edges
validated_preconditions: all row and column complement neighborhoods were classified exactly
the eight classes on each side are nonempty and cover the full vertex sets
adjacency is constant on every class product by neighborhood equality
the construction is used only in the upper-bound direction
new_scope_lesson: Successful reuse falsifies coercive growth at G16 but does not promote a uniform tool: future reuse must again prove full-history twins on both sides and cannot infer a lower bound from type growth.
non_guarantees: no exact value of D_intersection(G16) or rho(G16)
no later-level or uniform type bound
no lower bound, recurrence, circuit result, novelty, or P-versus-NP authority
software assurance does not add mathematical authority
